basics.name: Xiaoqi Qin
basics.label: Third-Year Undergraduate Student in Mechatronics Engineering
basics.summary: Third-year undergraduate at SCUT and research intern in Prof. Hao Tang's group at Peking University. My primary interests are video world models, World-Action Models (WAM), interactive and long-horizon video generation, and embodied AI.

work.name: Peking University
highlights: As part of an ongoing industry collaboration with YAHAHA, co-developed a multi-view first-person interactive world model for highly dynamic CS:GO scenes by adapting LingBot-World, a 14B action-conditioned video DiT; enabled synchronized generation across viewpoints, cross-view consistency, a persistent world state, complex action-conditioned interaction, and long-horizon rollouts.

Designed and trained a residual Map Memory conditioning adapter with LoRA for the 14B model; ran and debugged distributed experiments on a 16× NVIDIA H200 GPU cluster, diagnosing failures across the data, training, and systems stack.

Built the end-to-end data and evaluation pipeline from raw gameplay recordings to synchronized multi-view clips and Map Memory conditions, covering spatial grounding, cross-view consistency, world stability, and long-horizon behavior.
